viewing_check: Estimate 50-70 for the nine pieces. Single Diana-style troughs sell A$6-47 and Wade koala pieces A$12-37, so the lot probably totals A$100-250 if sold singly, but each piece is cheap and fragile to post. Check the underside of every piece for Diana, Remued, Wade or Brownie Downing marks: a marked Remued or Diana kookaburra can be worth much more, and unmarked ones very little. Look for chips and crazing. Prices stable, 2024-2026. Paddle steamer trough search returned 0 results.
